blocks.html:
This method defines indices on the data model. An index can be on multiple columns
and have conditions.

children.name: name
children.description:
The name of the index. If not provided,
Medusa generates the name.

children.name: unique
children.description:
When enabled, a unique index is created on the specified
properties.

children.name: on
children.description: The list of properties to create the index on.

children.name: where
children.description: Conditions to restrict which records are indexed.

children.name: type
children.description: The type of the index. (e.g: GIN)
